items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Terminology 53:1
items.html: The general Hassadim and the general Gevurot mean as they were rooted in the Yesod of AB, for there the root of the Gevurot was revealed in the light of Malchut that clothed in the vessel of Yesod, as written in Inner Light, page 336, Sub Header, “Returned”; see there. The same applies to Malchut. Likewise the general Hassadim were rooted there, in the phase of a truncated Vav, as written in the aforementioned Inner Light. But Hassadim and Gevurot without qualification mean when they come in a coupling, and then each of them has HGT NH, both in the Hassadim and in the Gevurot, which are actually five Sefirot. But the general Hassadim and general Gevurot are only a single Sefira, of the Yesod or of the Malchut. (p. 522, Item 45)
